name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: Dark Iron saboteurs threaten Loch Modan by planting an explosive charge in the Stonewrought Dam. You are sent to use a Disarming Mixture before the charge can bring disaster to the valley below.

sections.title: Averted Catastrophe
sections.body: The Stonewrought Dam holds back the waters of the Loch above the lowlands of the Wetlands. Dark Iron saboteurs have planted an explosive charge inside it, putting the valley below at risk. You apply the Disarming Mixture, and the volatile keg fizzles harmlessly. The immediate danger to the dam and the lives downstream has passed.

sections.title: Hinderweir's Relief
sections.body: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII welcomes your report with relief. He calls your intervention a victory for the Kingdom of Ironforge and the Alliance. Dark Iron infiltrators have reached deep into Khaz Modan, and their bitter cousins remain determined to ruin Ironforge's achievements.

faq.q: What was the goal of this quest chain?
faq.answer: The chain seeks to uncover and stop a Dark Iron dwarf plot to detonate explosives and destroy the Stonewrought Dam.
Dark Iron dwarven saboteurs planted the explosive keg inside the Stonewrought Dam to destroy it.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII is the dwarven overseer responsible for the Stonewrought Dam's maintenance, operation, and defense in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What would have happened if the dam broke?
faq.answer: If the Stonewrought Dam broke, Loch Modan's reservoir would drain violently and flood the Wetlands downstream, washing away roads, settlements, and vital transit routes.

aliases: how do you defuse the charge
faq.answer: You pour a specially concocted Disarming Mixture over the explosive charge, and the powder keg fizzles out safely before it can detonate.

faq.q: Is the Stonewrought Dam safe now?
faq.answer: The immediate detonation has been prevented and the dam saved. Hinderweir says its defense is secure only for the time being, as Dark Iron agents continue to menace the region.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can take pride in the Stonewrought Dam, a great work of dwarven stonecraft. Protecting it preserves Ironforge's pride against Dark Iron malice.
As an engineer, you know the importance of countermeasures and explosive theory when neutralizing an unstable demolition device inside a colossal civil project.
As an Alliance member, you help preserve key land corridors between Ironforge and the northern lands of Arathi and Lordaeron.
